eval-bot: nightly-eval alert for run rdx-nightly-2026-03-19-22: model=rdx-large-int4-v1 failures=3 severity=high

- suites failing: legal-regression, financial-fewshot, chatty-coherence
- symptom: spike in blank/short outputs (blank_rate=6.2% vs baseline=0.1%), hallucination score +8.3pt on financial cohort
- run link: https://ci.redwood/rdx-nightly/4387612345

marta: seeing this, assigning quick triage. who onboarded the int4 build?

raj: that was me — I landed the int4 kernels and qconfig yesterday, ran unit + smoke locally, looked fine. no staging alert then.

alia: FYI I saw a few short/empty completions from the same model in staging around 21:30 UTC. saved one example: "Transaction: 
" then empty. looks like tokenization or early-stop.

ken: quick guesses: 1) tokenizer mismatch (vocab/merges) 2) kv-cache truncation with quantized keys 3) batching edge-case that drops suffix.

marta: ok set initial severity P1-high until we reproduce. raj/alia pick ownership for reproducer and log grab?

raj: I can run a targeted reproducer. will run local eval harness across float16 vs int4 and save torch+runtime logs.

alia: I'll pull the staging request IDs and share example payloads. if tokenizer mismatch, we should see different token lengths between runs.

ken: add one more check — kernel rounding: sometimes int4 pack/unpack yields extra control tokens for longprefix, causing early EOS. also check kv cache lengths per layer.

marta: good. please run A/B: 
```
# repro command
python infra/eval_harness/run_eval.py \
  --model rdx-large --variant int4-v1,float16-v1 \
  --suites legal-regression,financial-fewshot --seed 42 \
  --save-logs /tmp/rdx-repro-4387612345
```

and attach logs. aim for results in next 45m.

raj: running now. note: nightly uses kernel qkern-v2. I will also try qkern-v1 to see delta.

alia: pulled 5 staging examples, attaching snippets below:  (copied inline)
- input: "Summarize the following contract clause..." -> model: 
- input: "Calculate the refund due for invoice 4321..." -> model: "

marta: if reproducer shows blank only on int4, escalate to runtime+ml. assign to raj + ken. I'll open an incident ticket.

ken: will start with kv cache instrumented build to log cache sizes. if we see mismatched sequence lengths at layer >0 we probably hit a serialization edge.

raj: quick update: initial A/B shows float16 blank_rate=0.05% int4 blank_rate=5.8% on same prompts. saving logs now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment rdx-large-int4-v1 -> 3 nodes: rollback initiated (manual) by marta at 22:09 UTC due to eval failures :warning:

marta: rollback done. next steps: (1) create GH issue with repro + logs + metric deltas, (2) isolate whether tokenizer or kv-cache via small-run with token-level traces, (3) try qkern-v1 fallback to see if kernel release introduced bug.

alia: I'll open the issue and link reproducer & staging examples. tagging @raj @ken.

raj: added comment in issue with logs and links to nightly run. initial hypothesis: qkern-v2 pack/unpack bug with int4.

ken: will add instrumentation PR to runtime, small change to log kv cache shapes and EOS counters. planning PR in 30m.

marta: thanks. marking thread last_message_ts when we have reproducer + issue link.

raj: reproducible — attaching minimal trace: token lengths differ by 2 tokens post-quant-pack on int4. sending to ken.

ken: confirmed, I can see an extra pad token inserted at layer 8 in the pack step. pushing fix branch now.

marta: awesome. lowering severity to P2 while patch lands, keep the rollback until patch validated.

deploy-bot: Patch build queued for canary (rdx-runtime/kv-pack-fix). canary scheduled in 45m.

marta: action items:
- raj: keep reproducer & attach full runtime logs (done)
- ken: PR + runtime instrumentation + patch (in progress)
- alia: issue + examples + QA checklist for nightly re-run (in progress)
- marta: coordinate canary + communication to cs if customer-facing regressions found

marta: closing initial triage, will update thread when canary completes. :white_check_mark:
